structure NonLeading (x : Points m) (r : ℝ) (c : Course C N p k) (j : ℕ) (P : Rep G (C.side (j+1) p)) (P' : Rep G (C.side j p)) (b : ℝ) : Prop where
  rent (h : j+1≤ N) (α β : Type) (F : Fintype α) (v : Fintype β) :
    let ζ:= readers (C:=C) (b:=b) (p:=p) x c.allow h
    let ψ:= readers (C:=C) (b:=b) (p:=p) x c.allow ((Nat.le_succ _).trans h)
    ∀ (H : α→ SourceAt G ζ) (K : β→ Lifted G ζ P.p.threshold) (z : ℝ), 0 ≤ z → z ≤ Perch.bill (-1/2) (clim C.path.levels k) →
      Light P H K (fun _=>r) S.coast.e z (z*Perch.w (clim C.path.levels (j+1))) → Background P K →
        Value.Notice P' ψ ((C.path.levels.clock.op j p).push (c.changeβ (j+1)) (Value.dust P H K)) (fun _=>r)
          S.coast.e (S.α*z+Perch.bill (1/2) (clim C.path.levels k)*z^2) (Perch.gas S.coast (clim C.path.levels (j+1)))

proof_context.conclusion: `NonLeading.rent` gives a source bound `S.α*z + bill (1/2) s * z^2`: a linear term with the stage constant `α` and a quadratic term with coefficient M^{1/2}.

structure Crew (c : Course C N p k) (P : (i : ℕ) → Rep G (C.side i p)) (R : Lead G C.S p) (ξ : Purse) (x : Points m) : Prop where
  ignition (g : ℕ) (h : g<k) (hk : middle C.path.levels ξ.band k ≤ g) :
    let t:=clim C.path.levels k
    ∃ y : Ignition R ξ.band x c h hk ξ.era.coast.Q ξ.horizon (P (g+1)).p (P g).p (ξ.sends t),
      Pleases ξ.era (P (g+1)) (P g) (ξ.sends t) ξ.goal (a:=ξ.horizon) y (ξ.cash t)
  vitality i : Station.width C.path.levels ξ.band k ≤ i → i<middle C.path.levels ξ.band k →
    NonLeading ξ.era x (Ship.allowance C.path.levels 2 k) c i (P (i+1)) (P i) ξ.band

proof_context.conclusion: `Crew.vitality` supplies `NonLeading` at each level of the interval, with radius `allowance 2 k`.
